description: 10 permanent solo YouTube slots — 2 Render sidecars × 5 encoders each (Tier C per sidecar on pro_ultra).

orchestration.rule: Slot-locked mirror — source platform live state drives YouTube slot live state.
behaviors: Each slot is permanently bound to one streamer (Twitch or Kick). Roster changes are rare (weekly at most).

When the locked streamer goes live on Twitch/Kick → start ingest + encode for that slot → create or reuse that slot's YouTube broadcast → prelive (RTMP/testing) → full SEO → public on ClipzWorld News.
YouTube broadcasts are NOT pre-created at roster setup — only reusable RTMP stream keys. No Studio Upcoming until source is live.
When the locked streamer goes offline → stop that slot's encode and end that slot's YouTube live on ClipzWorld News. Other slots are unaffected.
When the same streamer goes live again → same slot, same YouTube listing — no rebinding.
No grid compositor in this mode — only per-slot solo pipelines.
mustNot: Leave a YouTube slot live after the source streamer ended
Start a slot without the locked streamer being live on source
Swap streamers between slots without an explicit roster update

onSlotGoLive.thumbnailNote: Frame from live ingest via ffmpeg; operator may override in YouTube Studio
